evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.
evidence.locator: Exact selected converted-text passage; native/page/image/full-field inspection unverified

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
## Epic Flight Academy Aviation Maintenance Technician Scholarship

## TWO OFFERED – each at $25,000 value

Epic Flight Academy offers two scholarships for $25,000 each towards their
FAA Part 147 aviation maintenance technician program. This scholarship
supports entry level applicants to become an FAA-certified airframe and
powerplant (A&P) aviation mechanic.

Applicants may select one of Epic’s two aircraft mechanic campuses.
One is located in New Smyrna Beach, Florida. The other is located in Erlanger,
Kentucky at the Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport (CVG).

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

## Epic Flight Academy Aviation Maintenance Technician Scholarship

## TWO OFFERED – each at $25,000 value

Epic Flight Academy offers two scholarships for $25,000 each towards their
FAA Part 147 aviation maintenance technician program. This scholarship
supports entry level applicants to become an FAA-certified airframe and
powerplant (A&P) aviation mechanic.

Applicants may select one of Epic’s two aircraft mechanic campuses.
One is located in New Smyrna Beach, Florida. The other is located in Erlanger,
Kentucky at the Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport (CVG).

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• WAI online application portal submission

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
## Financial scholarships

**ISA+21 awards a minimum of two Scholarships of $5,000 each year to be used towards an advanced flight training program.**

**Prerequisite Information**

Applicants must satisfy all of the following requirements:

- Currently be enrolled in an advanced flight training program; or
- Have completed ab-initio flight training
- Must hold an FAA Commercial Pilot License or equivalent
- In pursuit of a career as an airline pilot
- Hold a current first class medical certificate

Conditions:

- Only _one_ Financial Scholarship Award is allowed in a lifetime
- Applicants may apply as many times as they wish
- Scholarship funds to be used for advanced flight ratings such as CFI, CFII, and MEI.
- Funds will **only** be paid directly to the approved flight training organization.
- The winner is responsible for travel, housing, and personal expenses during training
- Training must be completed within the following 12 months
- Open to female applicants, as indicated on their pilot certificate

Process:

- Submit [required documents](https://isa21.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/FINANCIAL-SCHOLARSHIP-FORM-b.pdf) by emailing [CONTACT ROUTE REDACTED]
- All applications will be assessed by the Scholarship Committee for eligibility
- Scholarship entries are due **November 1st** of each year
- The scholarship winners are announced in March of each year

[ISA+21 Financial Scholarship Application](https://isa21.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/FINANCIAL-SCHOLARSHIP-FORM-b.pdf)

## [CONTACT ROUTE REDACTED]

Email [**all applicable documents**](https://isa21.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/FINANCIAL-SCHOLARSHIP-FORM-b.pdf) to [CONTACT ROUTE REDACTED]

## Financial scholarships

**ISA+21 awards a minimum of two Scholarships of $5,000 each year to be used towards an advanced flight training program.**

**Prerequisite Information**

Applicants must satisfy all of the following requirements:

- Currently be enrolled in an advanced flight training program; or
- Have completed ab-initio flight training
- Must hold an FAA Commercial Pilot License or equivalent
- In pursuit of a career as an airline pilot
- Hold a current first class medical certificate

Conditions:

- Only _one_ Financial Scholarship Award is allowed in a lifetime
- Applicants may apply as many times as they wish
- Scholarship funds to be used for advanced flight ratings such as CFI, CFII, and MEI.
- Funds will **only** be paid directly to the approved flight training organization.
- The winner is responsible for travel, housing, and personal expenses during training
- Training must be completed within the following 12 months
- Open to female applicants, as indicated on their pilot certificate

- Submit [required documents](https://isa21.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/FINANCIAL-SCHOLARSHIP-FORM-b.pdf) by emailing [CONTACT ROUTE REDACTED]
- All applications will be assessed by the Scholarship Committee for eligibility
- Scholarship entries are due **November 1st** of each year
- The scholarship winners are announced in March of each year

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

# FRANCESCA NORRIS MEMORIAL SCHOLARSHIP APPLICATION FORM

[Selected prerequisite/condition/process/material instructions only. Biography and all profile/education input labels excluded; no form interaction or applicant data. Complete-page/image/full-field inspection unverified.]

ISA+21 awards two scholarships each year to aspiring female airline pilots.

**Prerequisite Information** Applicants must satisfy all of the following requirements: Hold an FAA Commercial Pilots License or equivalent Hold a command instrument rating In pursuit of a career as an airline pilot Hold a current first class medical certificate Conditions: Only one <PRIVATE_PERSON> Memorial Scholarship Award is allowed in a lifetime Applicants may apply for both the <PRIVATE_PERSON> Memorial Scholarship Award & ISA+21 Financial Scholarship in a given year Applicants may apply as many times as they wish Training will be conducted at US Aviation Academy or approved flight school Funds will be paid directly to the approved training organization The winner is responsible for travel, housing and personal expenses during training Open to female applicants, as indicated on their pilot certificate Process: Please complete this application form All applications will be assessed by the Scholarship Committee for eligibility Scholarship entries are due by **November 1st** each year The scholarship winner is announced in March of each year

### Please include the following information when submitting your application

1. A descriptive 500 word essay tell us about yourself, your achievements and explain your aspirations to become an airline pilot
2. Professional resume
3. Copy of all Pilot Licenses
4. Copy of your Aviation Medical Certificate
5. Copy of the last three pages of your log book
6. One letter of recommendation from a pilot who has flown with you
7. One personal letter of recommendation
8. Transcript for your highest level of academic study ( *if currently enrolled in a college/university)*
9. List of all FAA (or equivalent agency) check rides and their outcomes.
10. Details pertinent to letters of inquiry from FAA (or equivalent agency) regarding any aircraft incidents. Or select None
If you have any questions about your application please contact us by email. Completed applications to be sent to **[CONTACT REDACTED]** by **November 1st**

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.
evidence.locator: Exact selected converted-text passage; native/page/image/full-field inspection unverified

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Boeing Maintenance Training Scholarship $7,500 value

Boeing’s commitment to general aviation includes a maintenance training scholarship for a female individual currently enrolled in an accredited
maintenance program, or an accredited college or university should have a
GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale).  The recipient will be chosen based on
passion for aviation, commitment to pursuing a career in aviation maintenance, and the ability to complete training and must include two reference
letters highlighting the applicant’s character qualities. Funds will be paid
directly to the school, and the training is to be completed within one year.

evidence.excerpt:
## Dare to Dream Scholarship

## THREE OFFERED – each at $4,000 value

A $4,000 scholarship will be awarded to a WAI member who is working toward an instrument or multi-engine rating, commercial, or CFI certificate.
Funds will be paid directly to your flight school, and training must be completed within one year. The applicant must have a private pilot certificate,
and will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations, and dedication, as well
as contributions to her community. One letter of recommendation must be
from a pilot who has flown with you. FAA Class 1-3 medicals will still be required and preferred; BasicMed will be considered. One or the other is required. Prerequisite—private pilot certificate.
